entries.source: Introduction
entries.target: Utangulizi

entries.source: Learn indirect control: scout with a flag, supply your colony, and direct an attack.
entries.target: Jifunze kuongoza kwa njia isiyo ya moja kwa moja: chunguza kwa bendera, pelekea makazi lako mahitaji, na ongoza shambulio.

entries.source: Start introduction
entries.target: Anza utangulizi

entries.source: Your globules act on their own. You choose their jobs through buildings and flags. In this short introduction, scout a landmark, expand food supply, grow your workforce, and direct a small attack.
entries.target: Viumbe wako hujitendea wenyewe. Unawachagulia kazi kupitia majengo na bendera. Katika utangulizi huu mfupi, chunguza alama ya eneo, ongeza upatikanaji wa chakula, ongeza wafanyakazi, na ongoza shambulio dogo.

entries.source: Allow about 10 minutes. You can save from the game menu and resume through Load game. Normal hunger and combat rules apply. Choose Tutorial lessons from the main menu to practice more skills.
entries.target: Tenga takribani dakika 10. Unaweza kuhifadhi kupitia menyu ya mchezo na kuendelea kupitia Pakia mchezo. Kanuni za kawaida za njaa na mapigano zinatumika. Chagua Masomo ya mafunzo katika menyu kuu ili kufanya mazoezi ya ujuzi zaidi.

entries.source: Your choice could not be saved. You can continue playing; this recommendation may appear again next time.
entries.target: Chaguo lako halikuweza kuhifadhiwa. Unaweza kuendelea kucheza; pendekezo hili linaweza kuonekana tena wakati ujao.

entries.source: Scout the stone landmark
entries.target: Chunguza alama ya mawe

entries.source: Build another Inn
entries.target: Jenga nyumba nyingine ya wageni

entries.source: Supply your new Inn
entries.target: Pelekea nyumba yako mpya ya wageni mahitaji

entries.source: Grow the workforce
entries.target: Ongeza wafanyakazi

entries.source: Destroy the enemy Swarm
entries.target: Haribu Kiota cha adui

entries.source: Open Flags and place an Exploration Flag over the stone patch east of your colony. Assign one explorer. Watch it travel to the flag.
entries.target: Fungua Bendera na uweke Bendera ya uchunguzi juu ya eneo la mawe mashariki mwa makazi yako. Pangia mgunduzi mmoja kazi hiyo. Mtazame akisafiri kwenda kwenye bendera.

entries.source: Open Build and place an Inn near wheat. Assign available workers to construct it. Leave your existing Inn supplied.
entries.target: Fungua Jenga na uweke nyumba ya wageni karibu na ngano. Pangia wafanyakazi wanaopatikana kazi ya kuijenga. Endelea kupelekea nyumba yako ya wageni iliyopo mahitaji.

entries.source: Select your finished new Inn and give it at least one supplier. Wait for a worker to deliver wheat.
entries.target: Chagua nyumba yako mpya ya wageni iliyokamilika na uipangie angalau msambazaji mmoja. Subiri mfanyakazi alete ngano.

entries.source: Select the Swarm. Set its worker target to at least 2, and its production ratios to workers only. Keep both Inns supplied while a new worker is born.
entries.target: Chagua Kiota. Weka idadi inayolengwa ya wafanyakazi wake kuwa angalau 2, na uwiano wa uzalishaji uwe wa wafanyakazi pekee. Endelea kupelekea nyumba zote mbili za wageni mahitaji wakati mfanyakazi mpya anazaliwa.

entries.source: Find the enemy Swarm farther east. Use a War Flag to direct your warriors against it. Help is available if you need a reminder.
entries.target: Tafuta Kiota cha adui mbali zaidi mashariki. Tumia Bendera ya vita kuwaelekeza mashujaa wako wakishambulie. Msaada unapatikana ukihitaji kukumbushwa.

entries.source: Help / why?
entries.target: Msaada / kwa nini?

entries.source: Use the minimap to move the view east and find the stone patch. Choose Exploration Flag in Flags, place it on the stone, then leave placement with the secondary mouse button. Select the flag and request 1 explorer. Flags request units; they do not move them instantly. Explorers may stop to eat.
entries.target: Tumia ramani ndogo kusogeza mwonekano mashariki na kutafuta eneo la mawe. Chagua Bendera ya uchunguzi katika Bendera, iweke juu ya mawe, kisha toka kwenye hali ya kuweka kwa kitufe cha pili cha kipanya. Chagua bendera na uombe mgunduzi 1. Bendera huomba viumbe; haziwasogezi papo hapo. Wagunduzi wanaweza kusimama kula.

entries.source: Construction consumes wood delivered by workers. Choose Inn from the building controls (the building palette), place it in clear ground near wheat, and request 2 builders. A worker target is a request, not a count of workers already present. Keep suppliers at your existing Inn and Swarm. Any valid location counts.
entries.target: Ujenzi hutumia kuni zinazoletwa na wafanyakazi. Chagua Nyumba ya wageni katika vidhibiti vya majengo (orodha ya majengo), iweke kwenye ardhi wazi karibu na ngano, na uombe wajenzi 2. Idadi inayolengwa ya wafanyakazi ni ombi, si idadi ya wafanyakazi waliopo tayari. Endelea kupelekea nyumba yako ya wageni iliyopo na Kiota mahitaji. Eneo lolote linaloruhusiwa linakubalika.

entries.source: Construction and everyday supply have separate worker targets. Select the finished Inn and increase its operating target. A supplier gathers wheat and carries it here. Hungry globules eat at Inns; a building with no suppliers will eventually run out. Keep the wheat patch accessible.
entries.target: Ujenzi na usambazaji wa kila siku vina malengo tofauti ya idadi ya wafanyakazi. Chagua nyumba ya wageni iliyokamilika na uongeze idadi ya wafanyakazi wa kuihudumia. Msambazaji hukusanya ngano na kuileta hapa. Viumbe wenye njaa hula katika nyumba za wageni; jengo lisilo na wasambazaji hatimaye litaishiwa. Hakikisha eneo la ngano linafikika.

entries.source: The Swarm consumes wheat to produce units. Set worker production to 1 and explorer and warrior production to 0. Increase the Swarm worker target to 2 or more. More suppliers can deliver wheat faster, but they compete with other jobs. Maintain food supply at both Inns.
entries.target: Kiota hutumia ngano kuzalisha viumbe. Weka uzalishaji wa wafanyakazi kuwa 1, na wa wagunduzi na mashujaa kuwa 0. Ongeza idadi inayolengwa ya wafanyakazi wa Kiota hadi 2 au zaidi. Wasambazaji wengi wanaweza kuleta ngano haraka zaidi, lakini wanahitajika pia katika kazi nyingine. Dumisha usambazaji wa chakula katika nyumba zote mbili za wageni.

entries.source: Open Flags, choose War Flag, and place it over the enemy Swarm east of the stone. Select the flag and request up to 4 warriors. A small radius keeps them concentrated. Leave placement with the secondary mouse button before selecting the flag. If no warriors remain, produce more at the Swarm. Warriors may stop to eat; keep the Inns supplied.
entries.target: Fungua Bendera, chagua Bendera ya vita, na uiweke juu ya Kiota cha adui mashariki mwa mawe. Chagua bendera na uombe hadi mashujaa 4. Nusukipenyo kidogo huwafanya wajikusanye karibu. Toka kwenye hali ya kuweka kwa kitufe cha pili cha kipanya kabla ya kuchagua bendera. Ikiwa hakuna mashujaa waliobaki, zalisha wengine katika Kiota. Mashujaa wanaweza kusimama kula; endelea kupelekea nyumba za wageni mahitaji.

entries.source: Your explorer needs an assigned Exploration Flag at the eastern stone patch. Check its target and explorer count.
entries.target: Mgunduzi wako anahitaji Bendera ya uchunguzi yenye mgawo wa kazi kwenye eneo la mawe la mashariki. Kagua eneo inalolenga na idadi ya wagunduzi.

entries.source: If you removed the new Inn, build another. Otherwise check the construction site and its worker target. Existing supply jobs may occupy your workers; keep food running while making builders available.
entries.target: Ikiwa uliondoa nyumba mpya ya wageni, jenga nyingine. Vinginevyo kagua eneo la ujenzi na idadi yake inayolengwa ya wafanyakazi. Kazi za usambazaji zilizopo zinaweza kuwashughulisha wafanyakazi wako; dumisha chakula huku ukiwapata wajenzi.

entries.source: Select the finished new Inn. Check its worker target and watch for wheat deliveries. Workers may need time to travel or eat.
entries.target: Chagua nyumba mpya ya wageni iliyokamilika. Kagua idadi yake inayolengwa ya wafanyakazi na uangalie ngano ikiletwa. Wafanyakazi wanaweza kuhitaji muda wa kusafiri au kula.

entries.source: Check Swarm supply and worker-only production. Keep the Inns supplied while waiting for another worker.
entries.target: Kagua usambazaji wa Kiota na uzalishaji wa wafanyakazi pekee. Endelea kupelekea nyumba za wageni mahitaji ukisubiri mfanyakazi mwingine.

entries.source: Check your War Flag, requested warrior count, and food supply. Your warriors need time to travel and attack.
entries.target: Kagua Bendera yako ya vita, idadi ya mashujaa walioombwa, na usambazaji wa chakula. Mashujaa wako wanahitaji muda wa kusafiri na kushambulia.

entries.source: No assigned Exploration Flag was found. Place one on the stone east of your base and request 1 explorer.
entries.target: Hakuna Bendera ya uchunguzi yenye mgawo wa kazi iliyopatikana. Weka moja juu ya mawe mashariki mwa kituo chako na uombe mgunduzi 1.

entries.source: Your new Inn or building site has a worker target of 0. Select it and request workers.
entries.target: Lengo la idadi ya wafanyakazi katika nyumba yako mpya ya wageni au eneo la ujenzi ni 0. Chagua nyumba hiyo au eneo hilo na uombe wafanyakazi.

entries.source: No assigned War Flag was found at the enemy base. Place one over the eastern enemy Swarm and request warriors.
entries.target: Hakuna Bendera ya vita yenye mgawo wa kazi iliyopatikana katika kituo cha adui. Weka moja juu ya Kiota cha adui cha mashariki na uombe mashujaa.

entries.source: A unit or building needed for this lesson has been lost. Load an earlier save or restart this lesson from the game menu.
entries.target: Umepoteza kiumbe au jengo linalohitajika kwa somo hili. Pakia hifadhi ya awali au anza somo hili upya kupitia menyu ya mchezo.

entries.source: Introduction complete
entries.target: Utangulizi umekamilika

entries.source: You directed autonomous globules, expanded food supply, grew the colony, and organized an attack. Continue with Tutorial lessons for training, upgrades, and defense, or return to the main menu to start a match.
entries.target: Umeongoza viumbe wanaojitendea wenyewe, ukaongeza usambazaji wa chakula, ukapanua makazi, na ukapanga shambulio. Endelea na Masomo ya mafunzo kwa mazoezi, maboresho, na ulinzi, au rudi kwenye menyu kuu kuanza mechi.

Select the flag and request 1 explorer using its assigned-unit target. Globules travel on their own and may stop to eat.

entries.source: Hospitals and healing
entries.target: Hospitali na matibabu

entries.source: Build a Hospital and help a wounded worker recover. The colony starts fed, with one injured worker.
entries.target: Jenga Hospitali na umsaidie mfanyakazi aliyejeruhiwa apone. Makazi yanaanza yakiwa na chakula cha kutosha, na mfanyakazi mmoja aliyejeruhiwa.

entries.source: Your Hospital restored an injured globule. Keep Inns supplied: hunger can injure units again.
entries.target: Hospitali yako imemponya kiumbe aliyejeruhiwa. Endelea kupelekea nyumba za wageni mahitaji: njaa inaweza kuwajeruhi viumbe tena.

entries.source: Build a Hospital in clear ground; assign 2 builders. Leave room for globules to enter and exit. Hospitals heal injuries; Inns supply food. This patient is already fed.
entries.target: Jenga Hospitali kwenye ardhi wazi; pangia wajenzi 2. Acha nafasi ili viumbe waweze kuingia na kutoka. Hospitali hutibu majeraha; nyumba za wageni hutoa chakula. Mgonjwa huyu tayari amekula.

entries.source: Build a Racetrack and observe an existing worker learn to walk faster.
entries.target: Jenga Uwanja wa mbio na utazame mfanyakazi aliyepo akijifunza kutembea haraka zaidi.

entries.source: Your workers learned faster walking. Training improves the workers you have; it does not replace the colony food supply.
entries.target: Wafanyakazi wako wamejifunza kutembea haraka zaidi. Mafunzo huboresha wafanyakazi ulio nao; hayachukui nafasi ya usambazaji wa chakula wa makazi.

entries.source: Build a Racetrack in the marked clearing; assign builders. A Racetrack needs wood and stone. Leave a gap around its edges for entry, exit and later expansion.
entries.target: Jenga Uwanja wa mbio katika eneo wazi lililowekwa alama; pangia wajenzi. Uwanja wa mbio unahitaji kuni na mawe. Acha nafasi kuzunguka kingo zake kwa kuingia, kutoka na upanuzi wa baadaye.

entries.target: Fundisha waogeleaji, kisha tumia mwani wa kidimbwi kujenga Shule.

entries.source: A swimmer delivered water resources for your School. Water access expands the jobs your colony can perform.
entries.target: Mwogeleaji ameleta malighafi za majini kwa ajili ya Shule yako. Kufikia maji huongeza kazi ambazo makazi yako yanaweza kufanya.

entries.source: Build a Swimming Pool west of the pond; assign builders. Leave space around the pool. A worker cannot gather algae in deep water until it has learned to swim.
entries.target: Jenga Bwawa la kuogelea magharibi mwa kidimbwi; pangia wajenzi. Acha nafasi kuzunguka bwawa. Mfanyakazi hawezi kukusanya mwani kwenye maji yenye kina kirefu mpaka awe amejifunza kuogelea.
